$Comment: What each of Old Jack's four dailies pays. Every roll is read on its own: the first and the
last always pay, the two between are chances on top. Chance is a percent from 0 to 100. Sweets
and festival tokens (what every season pays) pay through the Currency reward kind; a companion
mod adds rolls with a file naming this table in ContributesTo.
Text names the reward on a quest (Old Jack's Daily Pay instead of Loot Bundle) and gives its
hover a line; the hover then lists what this table pays, a companion mod's rolls included.
HideInPreview keeps the rare Lantern Bomb out of that list, which then ends saying there are a
few more rare finds; the roll pays the same.
Name: Hallows_Eve_Daily_Pay
